selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from the oceans and rivers?
questions.answer: They show that Allah is the only God.

questions.question: Did the traveler think he saw all the truths in the seas and rivers, or only a very small part?
questions.answer: Only a very small part.

questions.question: Who joins the seas in giving this message?
questions.answer: The rivers do too.

questions.question: What words do the seas say together?
questions.answer: They say that no one is God except Allah.

questions.question: How strong is the witness of the seas described?
questions.answer: It is very strong and matches how great and wide they are.

questions.question: Which living things help as witnesses from the water?
questions.answer: The creatures living in the seas and rivers.

questions.question: What does it mean that the seas speak all together?
questions.answer: It means they give one shared message, not different ones.

questions.question: What is one main idea of the passage?
questions.answer: The seas, rivers, and water creatures point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What natural things are talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The seas, the rivers, and what lives in them.

questions.question: What did the traveler notice about the message of the seas?
questions.answer: He noticed that they clearly point to Allah.

questions.question: Are the water creatures left out, or are they part of the witness?
questions.answer: They are part of the witness.

questions.question: What belief is being supported in the passage?
questions.answer: Belief that Allah is One.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention many creatures in the water?
questions.answer: To show there are many signs and witnesses.

questions.question: When the passage says the witness can be seen, what does that tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us the signs are open to notice.

questions.question: What qualities of the ordering of the seas and rivers are mentioned?
questions.answer: It is wide and orderly.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The seas, rivers, and their creatures all testify to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: In this passage, who is learning from the seas and rivers?
questions.answer: The traveler.

questions.question: What did he see in the seas and rivers besides water?
questions.answer: Truths and signs that point to Allah.

questions.question: What do all the seas and rivers point to together?
questions.answer: They point to Allah’s necessary existence and oneness.

questions.question: What makes their witness bigger and stronger in the passage?
questions.answer: Their great size and all that they contain.

questions.question: What other things inside the water support this witness?
questions.answer: All the creatures in them.

questions.question: If many different water creatures all count as witnesses, what does that suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests the signs of Allah are many and spread everywhere in them.

questions.question: Does the passage describe the care of the seas and rivers as messy or organized?
questions.answer: Organized.

questions.question: What part of nature gives testimony in this passage?
questions.answer: The oceans and the rivers.
